thread:
maria: Heads-up: fuzzbench found a 'snowball' hit-rate regression in the KV prefix cache under concurrent replay runs. Repro steps + logs below. @oliver @sandeep :eyes:

oliver: Oof. Short summary? numbers?

maria: On replay harness (prod-traces-Jan), qps=1200, median seq_len=256, batching tuned for low p50. Observed KV hit-rate drop from 92% -> 68% over ~40s while load stayed steady. p95 token latency up ~18% on small batch sizes (1-4).

sandeep: Is this synth or replay? apples-to-apples?

maria: Replay. I ran synth with the same seq_len/distribution and it only dropped 92% -> 88%. So replay ordering/prefix clustering appears to trigger eviction "snowballing" that synth doesn't capture.

oliver: Can you paste the fuzzbench config you used?

maria: ```
replay_source: prod-traces/2026-01
target_qps: 1200
concurrency: 256
batching: { mode: adaptive, max_batch: 32, min_batch: 1 }
kernel_toggles: { kv_prefetch: true, prefetch_stride: 6, kernel_swap: auto }
metrics: { report_interval_s: 5 }
```

jay: Might be prefetch-stride heuristic misses clustered prefixes for a subset of clients, causing repeated cold fills and thrash. We saw similar pattern when stride was 4.

sandeep: I'll run the replay with sticky client-affinity to force locality and see if hit-rate stabilizes. Also will run with kernel selection forced to minikernel vs full to isolate kernel scheduling impact.

perf-bot: Perf run queued: job id fb-18321045X. Estimated 45m. Link: https://perf.redwood/jobs/fb-18321045X :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: From profiles: eviction-rate jumps from ~420/s to ~2.1k/s during the regression window. KV map size stays flat -> likely replacement thrash rather than growth.

oliver: Any GPU stalls or kernel switch noise in the trace? share perf trace snippet please.

maria: ```
[2026-03-16 14:02:12] eviction_count=2100/s, kv_hits=68%, kv_miss_fill_latency_p50=4.3ms
[2026-03-16 14:02:18] kernel_switches=+14%, small-batch-serial: increased dispatch latency ~0.9ms
flame: https://perf.redwood/flames/18321045X
```

sandeep: Plan: run three conditions -> (A) replay baseline, (B) replay + sticky affinity, (C) replay + reduced max_batch (8). For each: measure hit-rate curve over time, warmup_time (time to 80% baseline hit-rate), eviction_rate, and p95 token latency. Also toggle quantized kernel path for B and C.

oliver: When you run, force kernel selection per-run (avoid autoswitch). Use flags: `--kernel=force:minikernel` and `--kernel=force:full` in separate jobs so we get apples-to-apples kernel comparisons.

maria: Checklist if someone picks this up: 1) tag traces used, 2) snapshot runtime config + kernel flags, 3) disable auto-fallback & autoscaling for the run, 4) keep run ids and attach flamegraphs, 5) export raw hit/miss timeseries.

jay: :thumbsup: I'll do a quick local repro (<10m) to validate warmup trajectory and see if we can micro-opt the prefetch stride.

sandeep: If repro is clean, we'll open a perf-regression ticket and assign to eng-runtime. Triage P1 for Dedicated customers.

oliver: Assigning to @oliver and @sandeep. Please include config diffs and the perf job link.

maria: Thanks all — I'll drop the initial perf-bot results and the raw timeseries into this thread once fb-18321045X completes. :party:
